name: 13472-sharegpt-8b-2gpupp2
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, both on ONE node (--gres=gpu:2). sm90, driver 570 / CUDA 12.4.
parallelism: PP=2, TP=1, DP=1, Ray executor, V1 engine core (VLLM_USE_V1=1, set in configs/tuned.yaml).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, bounded at 3072 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion. No cooldown.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, text only, no prefix buckets: prompt ~213 tokens (stdev 244, clamped 16..512), output ~216 tokens (stdev 208, clamped 16..1024).
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant handling short single-turn text exchanges for 512 concurrent users across two GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.7.2-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys borrowed from a later vLLM.
# V1 is not the default at this version; VLLM_USE_V1=1 is set in configs/tuned.yaml.

model: unsloth/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

pipeline-parallel-size: 2
tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: ray

max-model-len: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 512
max-num-seqs: 512

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
